info.title: Product API
info.description: A comprehensive API for managing products with authentication, image uploads, and advanced filtering capabilities

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of products with filtering, searching, and sorting options

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in name, description, or SKU

message.example: You are not authorized to view products

post.description: Create a new product with optional image upload

message.example: You are not authorized to create products

message.example: You are not authorized to view this product

put.description: Update an existing product with optional image replacement

message.example: You are not authorized to update this product

delete.description: Delete a product and its associated image file

message.example: You are not authorized to delete products

Retrieve a list of all available product brands
